description: Return pictures already published on orbitstudio3d.com for a world or a place: photos of printed models, renders made with the app, and the world's map texture, each captioned with what it shows. Use it when the user wants to see what a model looks like. Nothing is rendered on request.

place.description: Optional place name or id from search_places.

world.description: Which world: moon, mars, mercury, venus, ceres, pluto or charon (only the ones OrbitStudio currently offers are accepted).

name: get_preview
title: Show existing pictures
